description: This file defines the LoopNest class and related functions for loop transformations and analysis within the Torch JIT tensor expression framework. It includes declarations for constructors, loop manipulation methods (splitting, fusing, reordering, tiling), buffer compression, dependence analysis, vectorization, and other advanced loop optimizations used for code generation and transformation of tensor computations.

classes.name: LoopNest
classes.description: A class that provides utilities to build, analyze, and transform nested loops used in tensor expression computations, supporting various loop optimizations and code generation tasks.

methods.name: StmtPtr root_stmt() const
methods.description: Returns the root statement of the loop nest.

methods.name: getLoopStmtsFor
methods.description: Methods to retrieve loop statements (For) associated with specific tensors, buffers, or statements.

methods.name: getLoopBodyFor
methods.description: Retrieves the loop body associated with specific tensors or buffers.

methods.name: getLoopAt
methods.description: Returns the For statement at a specific path within the loop nest.

methods.name: getParentLoop
methods.description: Determines the parent loop of a given statement.

methods.name: getEnclosingLoopNest
methods.description: Obtains all loops enclosing a specific statement.

methods.name: getAllWritesToBuf
methods.description: Finds all statements that write to a specified buffer.

methods.name: getAllInnermostLoopsWritingToBuf
methods.description: Returns innermost loops that write to a specified buffer.

methods.name: getAllLoopNestsWritingToBuf
methods.description: Returns all loop nests that write to a specified buffer.

methods.name: simplify
methods.description: Performs simplification of the loop nest.

methods.name: sanitizeNames
methods.description: Sanitizes variable and buffer names for consistency and legality.

methods.name: computeInline
methods.description: Decides whether to inline given statements or buffers.

methods.name: inlineIntermediateBufs
methods.description: Inlines intermediate buffers within the loop nest.

methods.name: optimizeConditionals
methods.description: Performs optimization of certain conditional patterns in the loop nest.

methods.name: splitWithTail
methods.description: Splits a loop into inner and outer loops with tail handling.

methods.name: splitWithMask
methods.description: Splits a loop into nested loops with conditional tail handling.

methods.name: distributeLoop
methods.description: Distributes a loop over its inner body or specific pivot statements.

methods.name: unsafeFuseLoops
methods.description: Performs unsafe loop fusion without dependency analysis.

methods.name: fuseLoops
methods.description: Performs safe loop fusion under specified conditions.

methods.name: reorderAxis
methods.description: Reorders two loops (axes).

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Reorders a list of loops according to a permutation.

methods.name: tile
methods.description: Performs tiling on two nested loops to enhance locality.

methods.name: areLoopsPerfectlyNested
methods.description: Checks if loops are perfectly nested.

methods.name: hasLoopCarriedDependence
methods.description: Checks if a loop has loop-carried dependencies.

methods.name: fullUnroll
methods.description: Unrolls a loop completely, if bounds are constant.

methods.name: unroll
methods.description: Unrolls a loop with a given factor.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes loop bounds and steps.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Flattens a list of nested loops into a single loop.

methods.name: compressBuffer
methods.description: Optimizes buffer sizes based on usage to reduce memory footprint.

methods.name: compressAllBuffers
methods.description: Compresses all buffers accessed within a statement.

methods.name: getLoopStmtsInLoopNest
methods.description: Extracts a subset of loop statements from a loop nest.

methods.name: sliceHead
methods.description: Splits a loop into head and tail parts.

methods.name: sliceTail
methods.description: Splits a loop into tail and head parts.

methods.name: cacheAccesses
methods.description: Caches buffer accesses for reuse.

methods.name: computeAt
methods.description: Allows inserting a statement at a specific loop scope.

methods.name: rfactor
methods.description: Performs R-operator for reduction axes to facilitate parallelism.

methods.name: vectorize
methods.description: Attempts to vectorize a loop.

methods.name: vectorizeInnerLoops
methods.description: Vectorizes inner loops where possible.

methods.name: eliminateDeadStores
methods.description: Removes unnecessary store statements.

methods.name: prepareForCodegen
methods.description: Prepares the loop nest for code generation.

methods.name: findOuterFor
methods.description: Finds the outer loop between two nested loops.

methods.name: findOuterFor
methods.description: Finds the outer For loop between two loops, if any.
